title: 架构：可靠性、安全与可观测性

examples.en: We run the service in three availability zones to achieve high availability.
examples.zh: 我们把服务部署在三个可用区，以实现高可用。

examples.en: High availability wasn't a requirement for the internal tool, so we kept a single instance.
examples.zh: 内部工具对高可用没有要求，所以我们只留了一个实例。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个支付服务在设计上最看重什么？
situation.en: The top priority was high availability, because every minute of downtime directly costs us revenue.

entries.note: 形容词说法是 highly available：a highly available system。缩写 HA 口头也常用。

examples.en: We built redundancy into every layer, so losing one node doesn't take the service down.
examples.zh: 我们在每一层都做了冗余，所以挂掉一个节点不会让服务不可用。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个机房断电了，你们的服务怎么还能撑住？
situation.en: We have redundancy across data centers, so traffic just shifts to the healthy one.

examples.en: When the primary goes down, we automatically fail over to the standby within thirty seconds.
examples.zh: 主节点挂掉后，我们会在三十秒内自动切到备用节点。

examples.en: The failover took longer than expected because the health check interval was too long.
examples.zh: 这次故障转移比预期慢，因为健康检查的间隔太长了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：主节点宕机之后会发生什么？
situation.en: We fail over to a standby in another zone, and the application reconnects automatically.

entries.note: 动词分开写 fail over，名词和形容词连写 failover：an automatic failover。

entries.zh: 服务中断（事故，o 开头）

examples.en: We had a two-hour outage last quarter because a bad config got pushed to production.
examples.zh: 上个季度我们有过一次两小时的服务中断，原因是一个有问题的配置被推到了生产环境。

situation.zh: 面试官问：讲一次你经历过的线上大故障。
situation.en: The worst one was a regional outage that took down checkout for about forty minutes.

entries.note: outage 指服务不可用的一段时间；没到不可用的程度，一般说 incident 或 degradation。

examples.en: The pipeline is fault-tolerant, so a crashed worker just gets its tasks reassigned.
examples.zh: 这条流水线是容错的，某个 worker 崩了，它的任务会被重新分配。

situation.zh: 面试官问：单台机器挂了，你们的系统会受影响吗？
situation.en: No, the system is fault-tolerant by design. It keeps serving requests even if a couple of nodes die.

entries.note: 名词是 fault tolerance：We need better fault tolerance here.

examples.en: We set a timeout on every outbound call so a slow dependency can't tie up our threads.
examples.zh: 我们给每个对外调用都设了超时，这样慢的依赖就不会占住我们的线程。

examples.en: Nobody had set a timeout on that HTTP client, so requests hung forever.
examples.zh: 那个 HTTP 客户端没人设超时，所以请求会一直挂着。

situation.zh: 同事在 PR 里调用了一个第三方接口，但没做任何时间限制。你想回复：
situation.en: Can we set a timeout here? If their API hangs, this call will block the whole request.

entries.note: 动词“超时”是 time out（分开写）：The call timed out. 名词 timeout 连写。
collocations: set a timeout on a call

entries.zh: 带指数退避的重试（动词短语）

examples.en: The client retries with exponential backoff, so it doesn't hammer a service that's already struggling.
examples.zh: 客户端用指数退避来重试，这样就不会猛打一个本来就快撑不住的服务。

examples.en: We retry with exponential backoff and give up after five attempts.
examples.zh: 我们按指数退避重试，五次之后就放弃。

situation.zh: 面试官问：调用下游偶尔失败，你怎么处理？
situation.en: For transient errors we retry with exponential backoff, and we cap the number of attempts.

entries.note: backoff 是名词，动词分开写 back off。只应该重试 transient（瞬时）错误，而且操作要能安全地重复执行。
collocations: retry with exponential backoff and jitter

examples.en: We put a circuit breaker around the payment API so failures there don't exhaust our connection pool.
examples.zh: 我们给支付接口加了熔断器，这样它出故障也不会耗尽我们的连接池。

examples.en: Once the error rate crossed fifty percent, the circuit breaker tripped and we started failing fast.
examples.zh: 错误率一过 50%，熔断器就跳闸了，我们开始快速失败。

situation.zh: 面试官问：下游服务持续报错的时候，你怎么保护自己的服务？
situation.en: We wrap the call in a circuit breaker. When it opens, we stop calling the dependency and return a fallback.

entries.note: 熔断“打开”说 the breaker opens 或 trips，恢复说 closes，中间的试探状态叫 half-open。
collocations: wrap a call in a circuit breaker

examples.en: One slow database query turned into a cascading failure across four services.
examples.zh: 一条慢查询最后演变成了波及四个服务的级联故障。

situation.zh: 面试官问：为什么你们要给每个下游调用都加超时和熔断？
situation.en: Mostly to prevent cascading failures, where one unhealthy service drags down everything that depends on it.

entries.note: 动词说法：The failure cascaded to the upstream services.

examples.en: If the recommendation service is down, the home page degrades gracefully and shows popular items instead.
examples.zh: 推荐服务挂了的话，首页会优雅降级，改为展示热门商品。

situation.zh: 面试官问：非核心依赖不可用时，页面应该怎么表现？
situation.en: It should degrade gracefully. Users lose personalization, but they can still browse and check out.

entries.note: 名词是 graceful degradation。

entries.zh: 服务等级协议（对客户的承诺，缩写）

examples.en: Our SLA promises 99.9% availability, and we owe customers credits if we miss it.
examples.zh: 我们的 SLA 承诺 99.9% 的可用性，达不到就要给客户补偿。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们对外部客户有什么可用性承诺？
situation.en: We have an SLA of 99.9% monthly uptime, with service credits if we breach it.

entries.note: SLA 是对客户的合同承诺，违反了有赔偿；SLO 是内部目标，通常定得比 SLA 更严。逐个字母读。

entries.zh: 服务等级目标（内部目标，缩写）

examples.en: We set an SLO of 99.95% successful requests, measured over a rolling 30-day window.
examples.zh: 我们定的 SLO 是请求成功率 99.95%，按滚动 30 天窗口统计。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们团队怎么定义“服务足够可靠”？
situation.en: We define an SLO for each critical user journey, for example 99.9% of checkouts succeed within two seconds.

entries.note: 冠词用 an：an SLO（S 读 /es/，以元音开头）。

examples.en: We burned through most of our error budget this month, so we paused risky releases.
examples.zh: 这个月我们把错误预算用掉了大半，所以暂停了有风险的发布。

situation.zh: 产品经理问：为什么这周不能上新功能？你想解释：
situation.en: We've used up our error budget for the quarter, so we're focusing on reliability work until it recovers.

entries.note: 错误预算 = 1 − SLO。比如 SLO 是 99.9%，那 0.1% 的失败就是可以“花”的预算。

examples.en: Going from three nines to four nines would mean less than an hour of downtime per year.
examples.zh: 从三个 9 提到四个 9，意味着一年的停机时间不到一小时。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个系统的可用性目标是多少？
situation.en: We're targeting four nines, which gives us roughly four minutes of downtime per month.

entries.note: 三个 9（99.9%）大约是每年停机 8.8 小时，四个 9 约 53 分钟，五个 9 约 5 分钟。

examples.en: We've maintained 99.98% uptime over the past year, even with weekly deployments.
examples.zh: 过去一年即使每周都发版，我们也保持了 99.98% 的正常运行时间。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你怎么用一句话说明你们的服务很稳定？
situation.en: Our uptime has been above 99.95% for six consecutive quarters.

entries.note: 反义词是 downtime（停机时间）。

examples.en: We invested in observability early, so we can usually tell what's wrong within minutes.
examples.zh: 我们很早就在可观测性上做了投入，所以通常几分钟内就能看出问题在哪。

situation.zh: 面试官问：接手一个老系统，你会先补什么？
situation.en: I'd start with observability. Without metrics, logs, and traces, we're debugging in the dark.

entries.note: 三大支柱是 metrics、logs、traces。重音在 -bil- 上。

entries.zh: 上报指标（动词短语，e 开头）

examples.en: Each service emits metrics for request rate, error rate, and latency.
examples.zh: 每个服务都会上报请求量、错误率和延迟这几项指标。

situation.zh: 同事问：新的定时任务上线后，你怎么知道它跑得正不正常？
situation.en: It emits metrics for run duration and failure count, and I've added both to our dashboard.

entries.note: metric 是可数名词：a metric、key metrics。请求量、错误数、耗时（rate、errors、duration）合称 RED 指标。

examples.en: We switched to structured logging, so now we can filter logs by user ID or request path.
examples.zh: 我们换成了结构化日志，现在可以按用户 ID 或请求路径来过滤日志。

situation.zh: 同事抱怨：线上日志全是拼出来的字符串，根本没法查。你建议：
situation.en: Let's move to structured logging and emit JSON, so every field is searchable.

examples.en: Distributed tracing showed that most of the latency came from a single downstream call.
examples.zh: 分布式链路追踪显示，大部分延迟来自某一个下游调用。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个请求经过十几个服务，变慢了你怎么定位？
situation.en: I'd look at distributed tracing first. The trace shows how long each hop took, so the slow span stands out.

entries.note: 一次请求的完整链路叫 trace，其中每一段叫 span。

examples.en: We attach a correlation ID to every request and pass it along to all downstream services.
examples.zh: 我们给每个请求带上一个关联 ID，并把它一路传给所有下游服务。

situation.zh: 同事问：同一个请求在三个服务里的日志，怎么串起来看？
situation.en: Search by the correlation ID. Every service logs it, so you get the full picture of one request.

entries.note: 也叫 request ID。“透传”说 propagate：propagate the correlation ID across services。

entries.zh: 针对…告警（动词 + 介词）

examples.en: We alert on symptoms users actually feel, like error rate, not on CPU usage.
examples.zh: 我们针对用户真正能感受到的症状告警，比如错误率，而不是 CPU 使用率。

situation.zh: 同事问：这个新接口上线后，监控上要加点什么？
situation.en: I'd alert on the error rate and p95 latency, and leave the rest as dashboards.

entries.note: alert 作名词的搭配：set up an alert、the alert fired（告警触发了）。

examples.en: I built a dashboard that shows error rate and latency for each endpoint.
examples.zh: 我做了一个仪表盘，展示每个接口的错误率和延迟。

situation.zh: 站会上你想说：发布之后你会怎么盯着线上情况。
situation.en: I'll keep an eye on the dashboard for the first hour after the release.

examples.en: We were getting hundreds of alerts a day, and alert fatigue meant people started ignoring them.
examples.zh: 我们当时一天收到几百条告警，告警疲劳导致大家开始无视它们。

situation.zh: 面试官问：告警是不是越多越安全？
situation.en: No. Too many alerts lead to alert fatigue, and then the one that matters gets missed.

entries.note: fatigue 读 /fəˈtiːɡ/，重音在后面。

examples.en: We raised the alert threshold because brief spikes kept waking people up for nothing.
examples.zh: 我们把告警阈值调高了，因为短暂的尖峰老是白白把人吵醒。

situation.zh: 同事说：这个告警一天响二十次，每次都自己恢复。你建议：
situation.en: Let's tune the threshold, or require the condition to hold for five minutes before it fires.

examples.en: It turned out to be a false alarm; the health check itself was broken, not the service.
examples.zh: 结果是一次误报：坏的是健康检查本身，不是服务。

situation.zh: 你半夜被告警叫醒，查了之后发现服务一切正常。你在群里说：
situation.en: False alarm. The service is healthy; the monitoring agent just lost its connection.

entries.note: 更技术化的说法是 false positive；口头报平安时说 false alarm 最自然。

examples.en: The root cause was a missing index, which made the query time out under load.
examples.zh: 根因是缺了一个索引，导致查询在高负载下超时。

examples.en: We restored service first and looked for the root cause afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们先恢复服务，之后再找根因。

situation.zh: 经理问：昨晚的故障到底是怎么回事？
situation.en: We're still digging, but the root cause appears to be a connection leak in the new release.

entries.note: 根因分析叫 root cause analysis，缩写 RCA。

entries.zh: 缓解措施（名词，m 开头）

examples.en: As a short-term mitigation, we doubled the connection pool while we worked on a proper fix.
examples.zh: 作为短期缓解措施，我们把连接池扩大了一倍，同时着手做正式的修复。

situation.zh: 故障群里有人问：现在有什么办法先止血吗？
situation.en: The quickest mitigation is to roll back the last deploy. We can investigate once things are stable.

entries.note: mitigation 是先止血，不等于根治（fix）。动词是 mitigate：mitigate the impact。

examples.en: We deploy to one region at a time to limit the blast radius of a bad release.
examples.zh: 我们一次只发一个区域，以限制有问题的版本的影响范围。

situation.zh: 面试官问：为什么不把所有租户放在同一个集群里？
situation.en: Splitting them into separate cells reduces the blast radius. A failure in one cell only affects a fraction of customers.

examples.en: We wrote a blameless postmortem and shared it with the whole engineering team.
examples.zh: 我们写了一份不追责的事故复盘，并分享给了整个工程团队。

situation.zh: 面试官问：线上事故解决之后，你们还会做什么？
situation.en: We always hold a postmortem within a week, focused on what failed in the system rather than who made the mistake.

entries.note: blameless 指对事不对人。有的公司叫 incident review 或 retrospective。

entries.zh: 值班（待命处理线上问题）

examples.en: I was on call that week, so I was the first one to get the alert.
examples.zh: 那周是我值班，所以我是第一个收到告警的人。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们团队怎么保证半夜出问题有人处理？
situation.en: We have a weekly rotation, and whoever is on call responds within fifteen minutes.

entries.note: 作定语时加连字符：the on-call engineer、an on-call rotation。

examples.en: We do a canary release to five percent of traffic before rolling out to everyone.
examples.zh: 我们先对 5% 的流量做灰度发布，再全量上线。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么降低新版本上线的风险？
situation.en: Every change goes out as a canary release first, and we compare its error rate against the stable version.

entries.note: 也说 canary deployment，口头常简称 canary：The canary looks healthy. canary 读 /kəˈneri/，重音在第二个音节。

entries.zh: 回滚（版本、发布，动词短语）

examples.en: Error rates spiked right after the deploy, so we rolled back within five minutes.
examples.zh: 部署后错误率立刻飙升，所以我们五分钟内就回滚了。

situation.zh: 故障群里，你判断问题是刚发的版本导致的。你想说：
situation.en: I'm going to roll back the release now, and we can debug it in staging.

entries.note: 动词分开写 roll back，名词连写 rollback：a rollback plan。
collocations: roll back to the previous version

entries.zh: 功能开关（f 开头，不用 toggle）

examples.en: The new checkout flow is behind a feature flag, so we can turn it off instantly.
examples.zh: 新的结账流程放在功能开关后面，所以我们可以随时把它关掉。

situation.zh: 同事问：这个功能还没做完，能合到主干吗？
situation.en: Yes, as long as it's behind a feature flag that's off by default.

entries.note: 也叫 feature toggle。

examples.en: With blue-green deployment, we switch traffic to the new environment only after it passes smoke tests.
examples.zh: 用蓝绿部署的话，新环境通过冒烟测试之后，我们才把流量切过去。

situation.zh: 面试官问：怎么做到发版出问题时可以瞬间切回旧版本？
situation.en: We use blue-green deployment. The old environment stays up, so switching back is just a routing change.

entries.note: 和灰度发布的区别：蓝绿是两套完整环境、一次性切流量，灰度是按比例逐步放量。
collocations: switch traffic to the green environment
keep the old environment as a fallback

examples.en: The new API version is backward compatible, so existing clients keep working without changes.
examples.zh: 新版接口是向后兼容的，所以现有客户端不用改也能继续用。

situation.zh: 同事在 PR 里把响应体的一个字段删掉了。你想提醒：
situation.en: This isn't backward compatible. Older mobile clients still read that field, so let's keep it for now.

entries.note: 名词是 backward compatibility：break backward compatibility。也有人写 backwards。

examples.en: Authentication is handled at the gateway, so individual services don't deal with passwords.
examples.zh: 认证在网关层处理，所以各个服务不需要接触密码。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户登录这一步，你们是怎么确认身份的？
situation.en: We use token-based authentication. The user logs in once and sends a signed token with every request.

entries.note: 动词是 authenticate。多因素认证是 multi-factor authentication（MFA）。

examples.en: Authorization happens in each service, because only the service knows who owns the resource.
examples.zh: 授权放在各个服务里做，因为只有服务自己知道资源归谁。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户登录之后，怎么防止他看到别人的订单？
situation.en: That's an authorization check. On every request we verify that the order belongs to the caller.

entries.note: authentication 解决“你是谁”，authorization 解决“你能做什么”，面试里别说混。

examples.en: We enable encryption at rest for every database and storage bucket that holds customer data.
examples.zh: 凡是存放客户数据的数据库和存储桶，我们都开启了静态加密。

situation.zh: 安全评审时被问：如果有人拿到了数据库的磁盘快照怎么办？
situation.en: The snapshot would be useless to them, because we use encryption at rest with keys managed separately.

examples.en: Encryption in transit is enforced everywhere, including traffic between internal services.
examples.zh: 传输加密在所有地方都是强制的，包括内部服务之间的流量。

situation.zh: 安全评审时被问：内网服务之间的调用是明文的吗？
situation.en: No, we require encryption in transit for all internal calls, using TLS between services.

entries.note: 实际手段一般是 TLS；服务之间双向校验证书叫 mutual TLS（mTLS）。

examples.en: We follow the principle of least privilege, so each service can only read the tables it needs.
examples.zh: 我们遵循最小权限原则，每个服务只能读它需要的表。

situation.zh: 同事为了省事，想给新服务一个管理员角色。你想说：
situation.en: I'd rather stick to least privilege and grant only the two permissions it actually needs.

entries.note: privilege 读 /ˈprɪvəlɪdʒ/，拼写里没有 d。

examples.en: All external traffic goes through an API gateway, which handles routing and authentication.
examples.zh: 所有外部流量都经过 API 网关，由它负责路由和认证。

situation.zh: 面试官问：客户端要调用十几个微服务，你会让它直接一个个去调吗？
situation.en: No, I'd put an API gateway in front, so clients have a single entry point.

collocations: put an API gateway in front of the services

examples.en: We rely on service discovery, so nobody hard-codes the addresses of other services.
examples.zh: 我们依赖服务发现，所以没人会把别的服务的地址写死。

situation.zh: 面试官问：实例随时在扩缩容，调用方怎么知道该连哪台？
situation.en: Through service discovery. Instances register themselves on startup, and callers look them up by name.

examples.en: The service mesh handles retries and mutual TLS, so we don't reimplement them in every service.
examples.zh: 服务网格负责重试和双向 TLS，所以我们不用在每个服务里重复实现。

situation.zh: 面试官问：服务间调用的加密、重试、链路追踪，要每个团队各写一遍吗？
situation.en: No, we push that into a service mesh. A sidecar proxy next to each service takes care of it.

entries.note: 每个服务旁边的代理叫 sidecar（边车）。
